intro: Admission to IET's undergraduate and postgraduate programmes is made through the University's transparent Computer Based Common Entrance Test (CET), held across multiple cities. Programme brochures and FAQ documents are listed below; for anything not covered, the admission cell is reachable on the numbers at the bottom of this page.

tracks.note: Seven specialisations, full and part time

scholarships.intro: Students of IET can avail various scholarships offered by the State Government, Central Government, and other agencies. For detailed eligibility criteria, application procedures, and updates, students are advised to visit the respective scholarship portals and to check institute notices for renewal deadlines.
